howItWorks.title: How Does Bulky.id Work?
howItWorks.description: We connect retailers, distributors, and logistics partners to create an efficient and profitable inventory management ecosystem. Every step is designed to help businesses maximize the value of every product.

testimony.title: Testimonials
testimony.description: What do customers say about our products and services? See their experiences here.

section1.heading: About Us
section1.card1: We are committed to creating a sustainable, transparent, and mutually beneficial business ecosystem, connecting retailers, logistics partners, and resellers across Indonesia.
section1.card2: Bulky.id is Indonesia's first online retail liquidation company, helping businesses efficiently manage excess stock, returned goods, and failed delivery products.
section1.card3: We deliver innovative stock management solutions so every product retains its value and creates new profit opportunities for business owners.

section3.heading: We are here to support entrepreneurs, resellers, and SMEs
section3.p1: Through Bulky.id, business owners can access quality wholesale stock at more affordable prices, while also having the opportunity to start a business without large capital.
section3.p2: We also help partners increase profits through a transparent, efficient, and trusted distribution system.

section4.heading: Bulky.id Ecosystem
section4.p1: We collaborate with major retailers, distributors, and logistics partners across Indonesia. From collection, sorting, to distribution — all driven by a fast and reliable digital system.
section4.p2: Turning excess stock into new opportunities for business and sustainability.

section6.heading: At Bulky.id, every container and pallet is packed with care
section6.p: As Indonesia's first online retail liquidation platform, Bulky.id is here to help business owners get the best stock, turning surplus goods into new profitable and sustainable business opportunities.
